result.brief: 提出用统一“腐蚀格”刻画扩散与自回归解码路径，以调度代价预测不同解码顺序的性能，并在文本、图像、视频生成上验证，为混合生成模型的解码设计提供原则。
result.reason: Unifies diffusion and autoregressive decoding schedules via a corruption lattice, with verified predictions on text, image, and video generation; offers a design principle for hybrid generative decoding.
